title: Current year tax rates and income brackets (2026)
author: Canada Revenue Agency
why_deposited: States the 2026 Northwest Territories tier thresholds (3,003, 06,009, 72,346) produced by the indexation in s 2.11(6) of the Income Tax Act, which the Act itself does not state; used by the baseline-2026-10 encoding.

version.as_at_note: For income earned in 2026 (the 2026 tax return).

conversion.method: Python standard library (re, html): the <main> element only; HTML comments, scripts and navigation removed; each table row given as cells separated by ' | '; whitespace collapsed. Script cra_rates.py in the session scratchpad.
conversion.checked: Read through against the page as served.
